facts.text: I am thinking of getting a new keyboard for my 10-year-old niece.
My 10-year-old niece has been taking piano lessons.
I recently had to order a new set of strings online for my guitar.
The new set of guitar strings took about 5 days to arrive.
I think the Yamaha PSR-E263 would be a great option for my niece.
I want to know more about the different sounds and rhythms the Yamaha PSR-E263 comes with.
I want to know whether the Yamaha PSR-E263 sounds and rhythms are geared towards kids or are general purpose.
I want to know more about the built-in lessons and exercises in the Education Suite.
I want to know whether the Education Suite lessons are specific to certain styles of music or are general piano lessons.
I have been trying to motivate myself to practice my ukulele more regularly.
I think setting specific goals and finding a practice buddy could help me stay motivated.
I have been considering joining a ukulele meetup group in my area to stay motivated and learn from others.
I am considering using online resources or apps to find local music groups or meetups.
I think I will check out Meetup.com and Facebook Groups to start.
I have heard of Meetup.com before, but I have never tried it out.
I want to know whether it is a good idea to reach out to the organizer of a meetup group before attending or just show up to a meeting.
